title: Performance Optimization & Scalability — Request & Control Flow
purpose: Traces Request Acceleration: comparing Premium Tier (cold-potato routing on Google private fiber) against Standard Tier (hot-potato routing over public internet).
routing_rationale: Google Premium Tier ingests traffic at the edge PoP closest to the user, traveling over private illuminated fiber with dedicated SLA guarantees.

nodes.label: User Browser (London)
nodes.detail: User initiates HTTPS request to api.global.service.

nodes.label: London Google PoP Edge
nodes.detail: Anycast BGP routes packet immediately into Google private network at London PoP.

nodes.label: Transatlantic Subsea Cable
nodes.detail: Crosses Atlantic Ocean on Google-owned subsea fiber with zero public transit hops.

nodes.label: Compute Backend (Iowa)
nodes.detail: Processes API request and returns dynamic JSON payload back along private fiber.

steps.title: Immediate Ingress
steps.action: Packet enters Google network in London within 2 milliseconds of leaving client device.
steps.why_traversal: Minimizes exposure to unreliable public ISP transit.

steps.title: Private Subsea Routing
steps.action: Traffic travels across private transatlantic cables directly to Iowa datacenter.
steps.why_traversal: Guarantees lowest possible latency and near-zero jitter.

scenarios.label: Public Internet Congestion Spike (Standard Tier)
scenarios.root_cause: Standard tier routed traffic over public transit during transcontinental fiber cut.
scenarios.diverted_path: Packets routed through 14 intermediate ISP hops with 18% loss.
scenarios.blast_radius: High latency and timeouts for international users.
scenarios.recovery: Migrate workload back to Premium Network Tier.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted

scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
